documents.title: Annual leave policy
documents.text: Full-time employees accrue 25 days of paid annual leave per year. Unused leave of up to 5 days may be carried over to the next calendar year. Leave requests must be approved by your manager in the HR portal.

documents.title: Parental leave
documents.text: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks. Parental leave does not reduce your annual leave balance.

documents.title: Sick leave
documents.text: Employees may take up to 10 paid sick days per year. A doctor's note is required for absences longer than three consecutive days. Sick leave cannot be carried over.

documents.title: Remote work policy
documents.text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Working from another country requires approval from HR and the tax team for more than 30 days.

documents.title: Performance reviews
documents.text: Performance reviews happen twice a year in June and December. Employees complete a self-assessment and managers calibrate ratings across teams.

documents.title: Leaving the company
documents.text: When you leave the company, unused annual leave is paid out in your final salary. Return your laptop and badge to IT on your last day.

documents.title: Password reset
documents.text: To reset your password, open the self-service portal and choose Forgot password. You will receive a verification code by SMS. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are rotated every 180 days.

documents.title: Account lockout
documents.text: Your account is locked after five failed login attempts. Locked accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes, or the IT service desk can unlock them immediately after verifying your identity.

documents.title: VPN access
documents.text: The corporate VPN is required to access internal systems from home. Install the VPN client from the software center and sign in with your corporate credentials and multi-factor authentication.

documents.title: Laptop replacement
documents.text: Laptops are replaced every four years. If your laptop is damaged, open a hardware ticket and IT will provide a loaner device within one business day.

documents.title: Multi-factor authentication
documents.text: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, VPN and the HR portal. Use the authenticator app; SMS codes are only a fallback when the app is unavailable.

documents.title: Phishing reporting
documents.text: Report suspicious emails with the Report Phishing button in Outlook. Never enter your password on a page you reached from an email link. The security team reviews reports within one hour.

documents.title: Software installation
documents.text: Approved software can be installed from the software center without admin rights. Requests for new software require a security review that typically takes five business days.

documents.title: Expense reimbursement
documents.text: Submit expenses within 30 days with itemized receipts. Expenses above 500 dollars need director approval. Reimbursements are paid with the next monthly payroll.

documents.title: Travel policy
documents.text: Book flights through the corporate travel tool. Economy class is required for flights under six hours. Hotel costs are capped at 250 dollars per night in most cities.

documents.title: Corporate card
documents.text: Corporate cards may only be used for business expenses. Personal purchases on a corporate card must be repaid within 10 days and may lead to the card being cancelled.

documents.title: Invoice payment terms
documents.text: Supplier invoices are paid within 45 days of receipt. Invoices must reference a valid purchase order number, otherwise they are returned to the supplier.

documents.title: Per diem meals
documents.text: When travelling, meals are reimbursed up to a per diem of 75 dollars per day. Alcohol is not reimbursable. Keep receipts for any single meal above 25 dollars.

documents.title: Budget approval
documents.text: Department budgets are approved in the annual planning cycle in October. Spending outside the approved budget requires a business case signed by the CFO.

documents.title: Data classification
documents.text: Data is classified as public, internal, confidential or restricted. Restricted data such as customer financial records must never be pasted into external AI tools.

documents.title: Using AI assistants
documents.text: Only the approved internal AI assistant may be used with internal or confidential data. External chatbots may be used for public information only. Do not upload source code to external services.

documents.title: Incident reporting
documents.text: Report any suspected security incident, lost device or data leak to the security team immediately through the incident hotline. Do not attempt to investigate on your own.

documents.title: Visitor access
documents.text: Visitors must be registered at reception and escorted at all times. Visitor badges must be returned when leaving the building.

documents.title: Office hours
documents.text: Offices are open from 7 am to 8 pm on weekdays. The building is closed on public holidays. Weekend access requires a badge with extended permissions.

documents.title: Cafeteria
documents.text: The cafeteria serves breakfast from 8 to 10 am and lunch from noon to 2 pm. Meals are subsidized for employees and can be paid with the employee badge.

documents.title: Parking
documents.text: Employee parking is available in garage B. Electric vehicle chargers are free for employees. Parking permits are renewed every January.

documents.title: River bank volunteering
documents.text: Every spring employees volunteer to clean up the river bank near the office. Sign up on the intranet; volunteering counts as a paid workday.

documents.title: Bank holidays calendar
documents.text: The bank holidays calendar for each country is published on the intranet. Offices close on national bank holidays; customer support runs a reduced shift.
